title: Sippel Draft on Chat Control — Mass Surveillance Set to Continue, Sparking Renewed Protest
summary: Patrick Breyer advocacy press release flagging MEP Birgit Sippel's draft report on extending the Chat Control 1.0 derogation.
body: Editor's note. This candidate, routed under Privacy from a Scanner pull of patrick-breyer.de, was a 6 February 2026 advocacy press release framing Sippel's draft report as a vehicle for continuing mass surveillance. By the time it reached source validation on 5 June 2026 the underlying procedure had moved on twice: the LIBE committee rejected the Sippel framing on 2 March 2026, and the file is now inside trilogue under a different posture. Publishing the lead today would put a four-month-old, inverted-outcome advocacy framing on a live news site. Killed by Source Checker at confidence 0.35 under the stale-advocacy-procedural-drift pattern. EIC ratified the kill and filed Scanner freshness-gate guidance as THE-841 so this class of candidate is intercepted earlier next time.
